notes.title: We’re bringing a new progression system to Online mode!

items.text: You will now gain EXP points by playing matchmaking games, and the higher you place in the final scoring, the more EXP points you receive.

Gaining experience helps you level up on your journey to becoming the Master of (Online) Flamecraft! You’ll also be able to see everyone’s level during online games, so you’ll know how experienced your fellow Flamekeepers are!

notes.title: With the new progression system, we’re also introducing leaderboards

items.text: a weekly ranking that shows the players who have gained the most EXP during the current week, and a lifetime ranking that tracks the players with the most EXP earned since the rankings began. Start climbing that ladder today and get your name up there!

notes.title: Italian and Ukrainian language support is here!

items.text: We hope this makes it even easier for more players to feel at home among the little dragons in Flamecraft.

notes.title: Check out the full patch notes below for all the details

items.text: Added EXP points for playing matchmaking games. Players can now gain EXP to level up in Online mode.
Added a weekly leaderboard ranking players by the points they earn during the current week.
Added a lifetime leaderboard ranking players by the points they have earned since the rankings began.
Added player level indicators to online matches.
Added the ability to switch between online matches directly from the pause menu, without returning to the main menu.
Leaving an online game now takes you back to the online menu instead of the main menu.
Added Italian and Ukrainian language support.
Fixed tutorial issues in Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian where the instructions referenced shops that were not present in the tutorial setup.
Improved consistency in Solo Mode descriptions across all supported languages.
Fixed an issue that allowed Sun Fancy Dragons to be played after visiting a shop.
Fixed an issue that prevented the large La Petit Dragon panel to be minimized into the small panel.
Fixed minor visual issues affecting icons, shops, and text.

notes.title: Thank you for continuing to play Flamecraft and for sharing your feedback with us.

items.text: We hope you enjoy the new features, and we’ll see you soon with the next update!
The first patch for Flamecraft is now live on Steam!
In this one, we fixed many crashes that were interrupting your games, sorted out the bot opponents' manners in a couple of shops, and cleaned up some UI and endgame scoring issues.
Fixed Taylor not scoring correctly for dragons played with Fogo de Char.
Fixed A LOT of crashes occurring in different situations.
Fixed various UI issues, including frozen resource icons.
Fixed the resource panel and Fancy Dragons points displaying incorrectly on the end-of-game scoreboard.
Improved bot opponents' behavior in Funky Brewsters and Drake of Cakes.
Make sure to update your game and we’ll see you soon!

releases.displayName: Demo News and Seed Update + check out our friends' game today!

items.text: We’re so happy to see you’re enjoying the demo!
There are still 5 days left until the end of Steam Next Fest, but we're not quite ready to say goodbye to our tiny dragons just yet, so…
We've decided to keep the demo up for a bit longer! If you haven't had enough time to explore the town or get familiar with the dragons, you'll be able to continue playing!

notes.title: We've also launched a dedicated Flamecraft Demo Steam page

items.text: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247130/Flamecraft_Demo/"]

notes.title: If you've been enjoying the demo, we'd be very grateful if you left a review there. It helps us immensely and gives us valuable feedback as we continue working on the game.

items.text: But wait, there’s more: we have just updated the demo with a new game seed, which means the starting shops and decks will be reshuffled once again. Time to discover some new strategies!

notes.title: In the meantime, check out Demon Bluff, a fantastic game from a fellow indie studio! They’re also showcasing their demo during Steam Next Fest, and it’s just so good!

items.text: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522600/Demon_Bluff/"]
Demon Bluff combines the tension of social deduction games with the replay value of a single-player roguelike deckbuilder.
Your goal is to investigate a corrupted village, gather information from each character, and piece together the truth to uncover and slay every demon in hiding.

Each character is represented by a card - Villager and Outcast cards will help you track them down with information and unique abilities. But be careful - Demons and Minions have disguised themselves as Villagers and will try to mislead you. Will you be able to see through their lies?
Thanks again for checking out our demo! We're very excited about what's coming next and can't wait to share more with you soon.
See you in town!
